messages:
maria.docs: Heads-up — PR #482 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/482) updates the v2 migration guide under /versioned_docs/v2.0/. We need this merged before the release cutoff tomorrow 10:00 PT. CI preview failed linkcheck. Who can review + approve?

jen-ci-bot: CI: docs-preview failed on linkcheck: 1 broken link
  - /versioned_docs/v2.0/migration.md: `../integrations/old-sdk.md` -> 404

tom.eng: I can take a look in ~30m. if it's just a relative link we can fix quickly. :eyes:

alex.prod: Confirming cutoff is 10:00 PT tomorrow. If we don't merge by then, release branch will be cut from main at 10:00 and we'd need a manual cherry-pick to the release branch. Is the change blocking feature rollout or purely tutorial updates?

maria.docs: It's mostly a migration example fix and a small snippet in the SDK examples. Not blocking the runtime feature, but annoying for early adopters. Prefer merged pre-cutoff so docs site shows correct links.

leah.writer: I can patch the broken link in the PR and add a short note in the changelog entry. Will push a tiny commit. :+1:

sam.swe: If there's any risk to upstream build, we should gate the new example behind the docs-only flag and postpone the example until after release. But sounds low-risk.

maria.docs: Thanks @leah.writer. Can you also run the preview locally? My linkcheck is flaky on CI. Quick commands:

leah.writer: Running local preview now. commands I use:
```
# from docs repo
yarn && yarn build:docs
yarn tests:linkcheck
```
Got the same 404 on that relative path. Will update to absolute path to new integration page.

tom.eng: I reviewed the PR diff — small change. Approving now. :shipit:

jen-ci-bot: PR #482 status: approval from tom.eng recorded. CI re-run queued for docs-preview.

jen-ci-bot: CI: docs-preview passed ✅ (preview: https://deploy-preview-482--redwood-docs.netlify.app/versioned_docs/v2.0/migration.html)

alex.prod: Great. Maria — is there any reason ops/release needs extra notice if this lands pre-cutoff? We don't want last-minute doc churn without release notes signoff.

maria.docs: Noted. I'll add a one-line to the release notes draft and ping @alex.prod when merged. No other ops action expected.

release-bot: Release window reminder: next release cut scheduled for 2025-04-08 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT). Branch cut will use main at that time unless hold label present.

sam.swe: If anything feels risky, add label `hold/release` and we can merge post-cut. But looks safe.

maria.docs: Merging now after CI green and tom.eng approval. I'll ping again in release notes thread. Thanks all. :tada:
